name: mikroscope
description: Lightweight log sidecar for NDJSON ingestion, query, and alerting
author: Mikael Vesavuori

scripts.dev: npm run build:app && npm run dev:app:api-config && concurrently "npm run dev:app:serve" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.dev:app: npm run build:app && npm run dev:app:serve
scripts.docs: npm run docs:install && npm --prefix docs run dev
scripts.docs:build: npm run docs:install && npm --prefix docs run build
scripts.docs:preview: npm run docs:install && npm --prefix docs run preview
scripts.lint: biome check api app tests scripts examples openapi esbuild.config.mjs vitest.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json biome.json
scripts.lint:fix: biome check api app tests scripts examples openapi esbuild.config.mjs vitest.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json biome.json --write
scripts.format: biome format --write api app tests scripts examples openapi esbuild.config.mjs vitest.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json biome.json
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run docs:build
scripts.mock-data:quick: MOCK_LOG_DAYS=30 MOCK_LOGS_PER_DAY=30 MOCK_AUDIT_LOGS_PER_DAY=10 MOCK_LOG_TENANTS=20 tsx scripts/generate-mikroscope-mock-logs.ts
scripts.test:performance:quick: PERF_MS_FILE_COUNT=20 PERF_MS_LOGS_PER_FILE=250 PERF_MS_APPEND_RECORDS=800 PERF_MS_QUERY_COUNT=120 PERF_MS_TENANT_COUNT=350 tsx tests/performance/run.perf.ts
scripts.release: npm run build && npm run sbom && npm run scan && npm run licenses && npm run release:assets
scripts.scan: mkdir -p security && grype sbom:security/sbom.spdx.json -o json > security/grype-report.json
scripts.licenses: mkdir -p security && grant check security/sbom.spdx.json --config .grant.yaml > security/grant-report.txt || { cat security/grant-report.txt; exit 1; }
scripts.precommit: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
